carriers.title: Below the Flight Deck: Engineering Sailors Keep Theodore Roosevelt Mission-Ready
carriers.description: Launching and recovering aircraft across thousands of miles of open ocean requires more than pilots and flight deck crews. Within the hull of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71), the ship’s Engineering Department maintains the vital mechanical and electrical systems that power daily operations and sustained missions at sea.

carriers.title: As Simple as ABCs
carriers.description: On an aircraft carrier flight deck, there is little room for error. Aircraft launch and recover just feet away from Sailors working in a fast-paced, high-risk environment where training, trust and teamwork are essential. Lt. Cmdr. Alcides Sanchez knows that environment from both sides, as an enlisted Sailor, and now as a commissioned officer aboard USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71).
